author: Elastic
description: 检测macOS经可疑Launch Agent或Daemon持久化。对应需求：持久化。官方：Persistence via Suspicious Launch Agent or Launch Daemon。
name: 【默认】macOS经可疑Launch Agent或Daemon持久化
note:
## 调查指引

### 规则说明
macOS经可疑Launch Agent或Daemon持久化

### 为何重要
在重启或登录后保持立足点

### 调查步骤
1. 核对告警实体、进程/网络字段与时间窗。
2. 核对是否符合变更窗口与已知业务工具。
3. 关联同主机或同账号前后同类告警。

### 常见误报
- 合法变更窗口内的运维、发布或安全扫描

### 响应建议
1. 确认是否授权与变更窗口。
2. 无授权则隔离相关主机或账号并排查落地与外连。
3. 按主机与用户关联前后同类告警。
query:
file where host.os.type == "macos" and event.type != "deletion" and 
  file.extension == "plist" and
  file.path like ("/Library/LaunchAgents/*", "/Library/LaunchDaemons/*", 
                  "/Users/*/Library/LaunchAgents/*", "/System/Library/LaunchAgents/*",
                  "/System/Library/LaunchDaemons/*") and
  (process.executable like ("/private/tmp/*", "/private/var/root/Library/*", "/var/tmp/*", 
                            "/tmp/*", "/var/folders/*", "/Users/Shared/*", "/var/root/*",
                            "/Library/WebServer/*", "/Library/Graphics/*", "/Library/Fonts/*") or
   process.name like~ ("python*", "osascript", "bash", "zsh", "sh", "curl", "nscurl", "wget", "java")) and
  not process.executable like ("/System/*", "/Library/PrivilegedHelperTools/*") and
  not (process.code_signature.signing_id in ("com.apple.vim", "com.apple.cat", "com.apple.cfprefsd",
                                            "com.jetbrains.toolbox", "com.apple.pico", "com.apple.shove",
                                            "com.sublimetext.4", "com.apple.ditto") and process.code_signature.trusted == true) and
  not (file.path like ("/Library/LaunchDaemons/com.jumpcloud.*",
                       "/Library/LaunchAgents/com.jumpcloud.*",
                       "/Library/LaunchDaemons/com.wazuh.*",
                       "/Library/LaunchDaemons/com.zscaler.service.plist") and
       process.executable == "/bin/bash")
false_positives: 合法变更窗口内的运维、发布或安全扫描
setup:
## 设置说明

1. 目标 macOS 主机安装 Elastic Agent，启用 **Elastic Defend**。
2. 确认相关数据流有数据后再评估告警。
